title: The Epistemic Planning Domain Definition Language: Official Guideline
reasoning: The paper provides a technical specification and guideline for the EPDDL language used in automated planning competitions (IPC 2026). While it utilizes formal epistemology (Dynamic Epistemic Logic) to represent agent knowledge and beliefs, it does so within a purely computational and logical framework for AI planning tasks (e.g., Blocks World) rather than evaluating religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
